aboutMe.title: Full-stack web developer
aboutMe.heading: React products with a strong UX eye.
aboutMe.description: I build modern web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and practical testing. I care about clear user flows, reliable APIs, and interfaces people can understand quickly.
aboutMe.aboutWorkDesc: I develop full-stack web projects from responsive frontend screens to REST APIs and data models. My work spans product sites, learning tools, booking flows, and interactive apps.
aboutMe.approachDesc: UX thinking guides my implementation: I simplify flows, test important behavior with Vitest and Playwright, and troubleshoot details until the experience feels dependable.

technologies.title: Technologies & Tools
technologies.subtitle: A curated selection of the tools and frameworks I use to bring ideas to life.

items.js: Core language for web development, used in all my projects. Experienced in ES6+, asynchronous programming, and DOM manipulation.
items.ts: Type-safe JavaScript, ensuring code quality and scalability in complex applications. Proficient in interfaces, types, and generics.
items.react: Building interactive UIs with a component-based architecture. Expert in hooks, context API, and performance optimization.
items.next: Full-stack React framework optimized for performance and SEO. Experienced in SSR, ISR, and file-based routing.
items.vite: Ultrafast build tool for modern web projects. Leverages native ES modules for lightning-fast HMR and development.
items.tailwind: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development. Skilled in responsive design and creating custom design systems.
items.node: Server-side JavaScript environment. Building scalable network applications and RESTful backend architectures.
items.express: Fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js. Used for building robust APIs and server-side logic.
items.mongo: NoSQL document database. Proficient in schema design, aggregation pipelines, and data modeling for flexibility.
items.git: Distributed version control system. Expert in branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and collaborative workflows.
items.vercel: Deployment and collaboration platform for frontend developers. Optimized for Next.js with instant deployments and scaling.
items.netlify: All-in-one platform for automating modern web projects. Experienced in CI/CD, form handling, and serverless functions.
